records.description: RUSHSIFT is an offline visual search engine for your footage. Describe the shot you remember; it finds the real clip on your drive. Windows, on-device, read-only.

records.name: Silence Remover
records.tagline: Silence Remover — Cut the silence, keep the sound.
records.description: Silence Remover — Cut the silence, keep the sound. Free online audio editor that automatically removes silent gaps, trims and fades your audio files. 100% browser-based, no upload, no login required.

records.name: Cadence
records.tagline: The Duolingo for speaking your own language
records.description: Cadence is an AI speech fluency app for iPhone and Android that helps speakers notice filler words, review transcripts, and build clearer speaking habits, with only 10 minutes a day.

records.name: ThePHOTO.one
records.tagline: One photo. One spot. For photographers.
records.description: A space made for photography. No feed, no likes, no followers. Just one photo visible to everyone at a time. Share a photo you're proud of. It stays in the spotlight until another photographer shares the next one.

records.name: HelixAlert
records.tagline: Real-time Lincoln Tunnel bus delays alerts and bus info
records.description: HelixAlert tracks NJ Transit buses through the Lincoln Tunnel corridor in real time: next arrivals, live delays, and conditions on the Exclusive Bus Lane (XBL). No one tracks traffic in XBL which is very different from regular car traffic and one broken bus can create havoc in rush hour commute. Data is provided by NJ Transit. Independent project, not affiliated with NJ Transit."

records.name: Gift card
records.tagline: https://shorturl.at/N777M
records.description: Click this link earn gift card

records.name: MapAnimate
records.tagline: Flight Map Animation Generator
records.description: MapAnimate lets you create cinematic animated map videos showcasing flight routes and travel journeys. Select your airports, design the flight path, and export a polished video in minutes—perfect for travel vlogs, presentations, and storytelling. Ideal for content creators, travel enthusiasts, and marketers who want to visualize journeys with professional-quality animations.
